summary: Browser reload and independent tabs resume at their own addresses. Only the Rust preview holds the account bearer. A host-only HttpOnly session cookie and an exact-origin IndexedDB binding must match in the bounded host table; tab notifications carry no credentials. The existing account and board operations still check current access.
evidence: browser_reload_and_independent_tab_resume passed. After demotion, reloading 201 resolved the original session before reading Sketch and Ink read-only. An independent tab resolved and read only Outline on 202. Removing membership produced a successful resolve followed by 403; explicit destination retry after restoration issued one GET 200 at the same history entry.

A fixture lock made logout return 503. The first tab retained its list and the sibling retained and reloaded 202. Acknowledged logout returned both to clean identifiers at their own addresses without input in the sibling. Reload there made no protected request. A same-account peer signed in at a second preview port retained precisely its own verifier and resolved again.

browser_unavailable_then_rejected_resume passed. A waiting signed-out tab opened its board after sign-in in the other tab. A session-table lock made reload return 503 with Retry connection only. Explicit retry resolved the same session and reopened 201. After independent revocation, reload returned 401 without a board read; both tabs showed sign-in. Reload under the lock again made no session request.

Fresh database connections compared session verifiers and accounts privately, confirmed role and catalog grants, and checked ordered rows on both boards: 73 Sketch and 61 Ink on 201, 62 Outline on 202, all revision 1. The fresh-profile direct-entry, rejected-password and correction journey also passed.

preview_browser_session_is_origin_bound passed: neither half authenticated alone; wrong authority, ambiguous or foreign origins, missing mutation Origin and mixed credentials were rejected. Rejected mutations left sessions and rows unchanged. Cookie attributes and absence of a native bearer in the browser login result were checked. Native bearer access worked, and ordinary/navigation-only hosts did not accept the preview pair. Chromium's separate-port document request carried only the inert cookie and was denied.

All 10 browser_preview journeys passed serially in headless Chromium. All 11 loopback_board_access tests passed serially. cargo test --locked --workspace passed 26 tests using the separate browser-packets target. Workspace formatting and git diff --check passed. The worker shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs before execution; Node runner regressions remain unverified here.
The tab behavior matches the synthetic reference component comparison recorded in ROADMAP.md. Browser/host restart, deployment, saved views and live board edit synchronization remain open.
